additional_concerns: Footnote 3 is supplied in da12aecad4e68.u30.3569. The XML and web-form claims' missing-footnote uncertainties are stale. The XML permission is supported as a listed method, but its extracted conditions omit the required e-Cert; they must not be read as sufficient conditions for compliance.

The separately provided JFIU XML schema is absent. None of the opaque dependency IDs can be reliably mapped to it. The circular establishes the obligation to follow that schema without establishing its contents.

Both compliance candidates expressly exclude schema conformity from their XML facts. Their selected channel, method and e-Cert results must not be generalized to full XML compliance. The separate obligation to liaise with JFIU to arrange a technical test is also outside those formulas.

Footnote 3 requires a Hongkong Post e-Cert but does not specify the operational act satisfying that requirement. What JFIU operational guidance establishes whether and how a certificate must be supplied or used for a particular submission? That guidance and the prescribed PDF form are missing and have no identifiable supplied dependency mapping.

The date-only candidate includes the pre-9:00am portion of 2 February 2026. This differs from the operational-launch interpretation of 'following its implementation'. Preserve the date-effective wording, explicit launch time and blackout provisions as distinct evidence rather than silently equating them.

Timestamp candidates select an operational-launch boundary, including the launch instant. What authority establishes the governing timezone and resolves the boundary interpretation? Neither is expressly settled by the supplied text; no dependency ID can be identified for clarification.
Urgent blackout contact does not itself establish an STR submission. Automatic migration and later resubmission must likewise remain distinct from the original submission event.

The history candidate establishes whether a triggering event existed, not whether a duty remains outstanding after performance. FALSE requires sufficient history; the existential assessment is supplied externally rather than executed by the formula.
Non-filing events produce FALSE in node.29b224046d115582fbf223fb but OUT_OF_SCOPE in the other event candidates. This domain distinction must be retained when comparing answers.
Rule-wide conflict blocking is an evaluation policy, not a substantive restriction imposed by the circular. It can block an answer even when an alternative submission method otherwise suffices.
